Eight-Connected Component Filtering
nodes.rationale: The default three-pixel minimum removes isolated one- and two-pixel noise while retaining small predicted microaneurysms.

nodes.label: Lesion Grad-CAM
nodes.rationale: Grad-CAM is a secondary feature-attribution visualization; it supplements but does not replace segmentation, and no heatmap is fabricated for a class without a retained predicted region.

Authoritative Lesion CSV Mapping
nodes.rationale: Explicit CSV image-mask pairs are authoritative because row order is never used to match files and absent annotations are not assumed to be negative labels.

nodes.label: NAFNet SIDD Width-32 Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint is supplied through an offline bundle because its size exceeds GitHub's normal 100 MB limit; it is a SIDD denoising checkpoint rather than a retinal-trained model, and the loader never downloads weights.
